title: Game made with Claude.
author: Funny_Horror2212
selftext: Hello everyone, after 60 days of daily work with Claude, I've created the first version of my hack-and-slash mobile game. Vikings land in the world of Greek mythology and are looking for a way home. The game has different modes and mainly revolves around the Rift. There are 9 biomes, more enemies, and more bosses. After each biome, you choose to continue or extract resources; otherwise, you risk losing loot. Back at base, you build up your strength and go back in. What do you think of my idea? I really value honest opinions. Everything is my idea; Claude built everything. If anyone wanna try, all i need is your googel play adresse u will get a link afterwards.

comments.author: VenatoreCapitanum
comments.body: I love the animations, really nice. I assume you used foreign tools, I think Claude cant make it this nice.

replies.author: Funny_Horror2212
replies.body: Yes, exactly, the animations come from the Unity Store and Mixamo because Claude couldn't get them right using Blender, and without them the gameplay wouldn't work 😅. Claude creates the map animations himself using Blender. Are you familiar with this and do you have any tips on how I can improve the gameplay? This is my first attempt in this area.

comments.author: monkey-jax
comments.body: Have a light soundscape when playing in different biomes, the sound effects would drive me crazy, the menus look really ai, but I don't mind it that much, definitely needs a lot more detail in the world, looks very flat, even for a mobile game, other than that, good bones for a decent game

replies.author: Funny_Horror2212
replies.body: Thanks, i will work on that.

comments.author: mechatui
comments.body: Dam you even got AI to name your game

replies.author: Funny_Horror2212
replies.body: Maybe a good idea. I got the Story-plot and Twist etc. but the Name is Hard 😆. Thanks i will think about a Name.

replies.author: mechatui
replies.body: Wyrd plus some kind of word is the most spammed ai suggestion for fantasy games

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: the game opens with a serious rendered look and then it switched to a cartoonish look for the gameplay. Both halves look fine but it is a weird jump

replies.author: Funny_Horror2212
replies.body:
Thanks for your comment. The map thing was actually intentional. My thought was that the Vikings were a bit darker, and because they landed in the world of Greek mythology, it was more colorful. At least that's how I remember it. 😁

Maybe not the best set up..

comments.author: GoblinMatr0n
comments.body:
From second 6 to 7 in your video, the character carousel reset hard to switch from last character to the next one.   
The gameplay look neet, love the momentary screen stun when killing. The map doesnt feel viking ish, instead of lamppost maybe some brazier ? and if you have thing that generate light source, maybe having the time of the day be darker ?  

The life bar on top are way too small, im thinking maybe have a new system like bar next to the character so your eyes dont move too all around ?

replies.author: Funny_Horror2212
replies.body: Thanks for your feedback. I'll look into the health bar issue and test it. I've currently tried using a pulsating screen at low HP to ensure the focus stays on the character. The map design is somewhat intentional; they land in Greek mythology, and it gets darker with each biome. I based it a bit on old films. But thank you very much for your ideas; they're very helpful.

comments.author: YannLeCoomer
comments.body:
This looks better than 95% of the other stuff I see in this sub but those highly detailed portraits are just so obviously AI imo, I’d consider trying to develop a different style that doesn’t look like your prompt was just “make a Viking portrait with xyz clothing”

That and the run ani is a little silly but lol I mean not a deal breaker by any means. Good luck

replies.author: Funny_Horror2212
replies.body: Wow, thank you, that gives me hope! 😁 And you're absolutely right, the portraits are very obvious. I'll see what I can do about that. It was only because you mentioned it that I realized how silly the animation looks. 😆😆 Luckily, I'm still at the beginning and can adjust it. Thanks!
